title: composite-lint config
description: Settings for composite-lint (.composite-lint.yml): the action's inputs, as flat key: value lines. The action's inputs, and bin/lint.sh's options and LINT_* environment variables, take precedence; anything unset uses what's bundled.

languages.description: Languages to lint, comma- or whitespace-separated. If unset, they're detected from the files present.

paths.description: Paths to lint, relative to the repo root; comma- or whitespace-separated. Defaults to the repo root.

exclude.description: Git pathspecs to exclude, relative to the repo root; comma- or whitespace-separated.

go-version.description: Go version; set at most one of this and go-version-file.

go-version-file.description: File containing the Go version, e.g. go.mod (the default), relative to the repo root.

python-version.description: Python version used to run the Python-based linters; set at most one of this and python-version-file.

python-version-file.description: File containing the Python version, relative to the repo root.

terraform-version.description: Terraform version; set at most one of this and terraform-version-file.

terraform-version-file.description: File containing the Terraform version, relative to the repo root.

actionlint-config.description: actionlint config file, relative to the repo root.

actionlint-version.description: actionlint version; set at most one of this and actionlint-version-file.

actionlint-version-file.description: File containing the actionlint version, relative to the repo root.

flake8-config.description: flake8 config file, relative to the repo root.

flake8-version.description: flake8 version; set at most one of this and flake8-version-file.

flake8-version-file.description: File containing the flake8 version, relative to the repo root.

golangci-lint-config.description: golangci-lint config file, relative to the repo root.

golangci-lint-version.description: golangci-lint version; set at most one of this and golangci-lint-version-file.

golangci-lint-version-file.description: File containing the golangci-lint version, relative to the repo root.

hadolint-config.description: hadolint config file, relative to the repo root.

hadolint-version.description: hadolint version; set at most one of this and hadolint-version-file.

hadolint-version-file.description: File containing the hadolint version, relative to the repo root.

pre-commit-config.description: pre-commit config file (by default, the repo's .pre-commit-config.yaml, else the bundled one, which runs detect-private-key and check-symlinks), relative to the repo root.

pre-commit-version.description: pre-commit version; set at most one of this and pre-commit-version-file.

pre-commit-version-file.description: File containing the pre-commit version, relative to the repo root.

shellcheck-config.description: ShellCheck config file (an rcfile), relative to the repo root.

shellcheck-version.description: ShellCheck version; set at most one of this and shellcheck-version-file.

shellcheck-version-file.description: File containing the ShellCheck version, relative to the repo root.

tflint-config.description: TFLint config file, relative to the repo root.

tflint-version.description: TFLint version; set at most one of this and tflint-version-file.

tflint-version-file.description: File containing the TFLint version, relative to the repo root.

woke-config.description: woke config file, relative to the repo root.

woke-version.description: woke version; set at most one of this and woke-version-file.

woke-version-file.description: File containing the woke version, relative to the repo root.

yamllint-config.description: yamllint config file, relative to the repo root.

yamllint-version.description: yamllint version; set at most one of this and yamllint-version-file.

yamllint-version-file.description: File containing the yamllint version, relative to the repo root.

zizmor-config.description: zizmor config file, relative to the repo root.

zizmor-version.description: zizmor version; set at most one of this and zizmor-version-file.

zizmor-version-file.description: File containing the zizmor version, relative to the repo root.
